links.outcome: Readability (FKRE, FKGL) of ChatGPT osteoporosis responses versus patient-comprehensible level
links.effect: FKRE mean 28.71 (range 13.71-56.06); FKGL mean 13.25 (range 8.48-17.63); abstract states about 17 years of education needed. EQIP mean 48.71, 'serious problems with quality'.
links.quote: The FKRE scores spanned from 13.71 to 56.06 with a mean value of 28.71 and the FKGL varied between 8.48 and 17.63, with a mean value of 13.25.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's baseline information quality and readability (EQIP, FKGL, FKRE) for osteoporosis patient queries without testing a deployment safeguard or intervention.
